Amputated Hand

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your foe cuts through your forearm, sending your hand on its merry way.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (3) and @Condition[Bleeding] (2). Also, lose your hand – @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.zyocWSzEZEC826NS]{Amputation (Difficult)}.
